teaser.en: Its black seeds wear bright red-orange caps, strung into necklaces, while its termite-proof poles hold up the main frame of a house.
teaser.sw: Mbegu zake nyeusi zina vifuniko vyekundu-machungwa vinavyong'aa na hutungwa kuwa mikufu, huku nguzo zake zisizoliwa na mchwa zikishikilia fremu kuu ya nyumba.
teaser.dg: Tembeze nyiru zina kofiya za rangi ya kundu na ya chungbwa inayong'arira, na nkutungwa kuhenda mikufu; nazo nguzoze, ambazo taziriwa ni lutswa, nkuimisa muundo mkulu wa nyumba.

summary.en: *Mbambakofi*, the pod mahogany, is a large spreading tree of dry coastal forest and the Shimba Hills, prized as one of the most important timber trees known to Digo carpenters. Logging has made it rare outside protected areas.
summary.sw: *Mbambakofi* ni mti mkubwa unaotanda wa misitu mikavu ya pwani na Milima ya Shimba, unaothaminiwa kama mojawapo ya miti muhimu zaidi ya mbao inayojulikana na maseremala wa Kidigo. Ukataji miti umeufanya kuwa adimu nje ya maeneo yaliyohifadhiwa.
summary.dg: *Mbambakofi* ni muhi mkulu unaotandazika, wa matsaka makavu ga pwani na ga Shimba Hills, unaothaminiwa ni mafundi a mbao a Chidigo dza mmwenga wa mihi muhimu zaidi ya mbao. Kpwa sababu ya kukatwa sana, sambi ni adimu kondze ya maeneo ga hifadhi.

about.en:
*Mbambakofi* is a large, spreading tree that loses some of its leaves in the dry season. Its leaves are compound, with three to seven pairs of glossy leaflets.

The pods are its best-known feature: thick, flat and woody, splitting open to show shiny black seeds, each topped with a bright red-orange cap called an aril. The seeds stay on the tree and on the ground long after the pods have opened, and children collect them.
about.sw:
*Mbambakofi* ni mti mkubwa unaotanda ambao hupukutisha baadhi ya majani yake wakati wa kiangazi. Majani yake ni ya mchanganyiko, yenye jozi tatu hadi saba za vijani vinavyong'aa.

Maganda ndiyo sifa yake inayojulikana zaidi: manene, bapa na magumu kama mbao, yanayopasuka na kuonyesha mbegu nyeusi zinazong'aa, kila moja ikiwa na kifuniko chekundu-machungwa kinachong'aa kiitwacho aril. Mbegu hubaki mtini na ardhini muda mrefu baada ya maganda kufunguka, na watoto huziokota.
about.dg:
*Mbambakofi* ni muhi mkulu unaotandazika, ambao makodza ganjina ganagbwa msimu wa kazikazi. Makodzage ganamera kpwa mafungu: chila fungu rina jozi tahu hadi sabaa za makodza madide ganagong'arira.

Makakayage ndigo ganagomanyikana zaidi: ni maziho, mabapa na ga mbao, na ganaahuka na kuonyesa tembe nyiru zinazong'arira, na chila tembe ina kofiya ya rangi ya kundu na ya chungbwa inayong'arira, inayoihwa *aril*. Tembe zinasala muhini na photsi kpwa muda mure bada ya makakaya kuahuka, na ana nkuzitsola.

where.en: It grows in lowland dry forest, *Brachystegia* woodland and thicket on the coastal plain and in the Shimba Hills. Large trees are now mostly found in protected forests and kayas, where they have been spared from logging.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu mikavu ya nyanda za chini, misitu ya *Brachystegia* na vichaka vizito katika tambarare ya pwani na Milima ya Shimba. Miti mikubwa sasa hupatikana hasa katika misitu iliyohifadhiwa na kaya, ambako imesalimika na ukataji miti.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka makavu ga herera, matsaka ga *Brachystegia* na vitsaka kpwenye herera ya pwani na Shimba Hills. Mihi mikulu sambi inaphahikana zaidi kpwenye matsaka ga hifadhi na makaya, ambako yarichwa bila kukatwa.

uses.en:
The wood is heavy, strong and handsome, used for doors, furniture and building. Its poles are very hard and resist termites, so they are chosen for the main supports of a house. Larger trunks have been used to make canoes and dhows.

The bright seeds are strung as necklaces. The tree gives shade, and it is also used in medicine.
uses.sw:
Mbao yake ni nzito, imara na ya kupendeza, inayotumika kwa milango, samani na ujenzi. Nguzo zake ni ngumu sana na haziliwi na mchwa, hivyo huchaguliwa kwa nguzo kuu za nyumba. Mashina makubwa zaidi yametumika kutengeneza mitumbwi na majahazi.

Mbegu zake zinazong'aa hutungwa kuwa mikufu. Mti huu hutoa kivuli, na pia hutumika katika dawa.
uses.dg:
Nyama za muhi hinyu ni nziho, zina nguvu na ni nono; nkuhumirwa kuhenda miryango, fanicha na kudzenga. Nguzoze ni ngumu sana na taziriwa ni lutswa, kpwa hivyo nkutsambulwa kukala nguzo kulu za nyumba. Makolo makulu gakahumirwa kuhenda mitumbwi na majahazi.

Tembe zinazong'arira nkutungwa kuhenda mikufu. Muhi hinyu unalavya pepho, na piya nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

culture.en: Pakia lists *mbambakofi* among the most important local sawn-timber trees known to Digo carpenters.
culture.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha *mbambakofi* miongoni mwa miti muhimu zaidi ya mbao za kupasuliwa inayojulikana na maseremala wa Kidigo.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika *mbambakofi* kahi ya mihi ya kahi ya tsi inayokereswa mbao, iriyo muhimu zaidi na inayomanyikana ni mafundi a mbao a Chidigo.

names.en: Pakia and Maundu and Tengnäs give the Digo name *mbambakofi*, which is also the Swahili name and the headword in the Mgombato dictionary. Mgombato glosses it as lucky-bean tree, pod mahogany or mahogany tree, and lists many other names from the region, including *mbaria*, *mbarikia*, *mkongo*, *mkola* and *mtame*. In Giriama it is *mwamba*. In English it is the pod mahogany or mahogany bean, and its scientific name is *Afzelia quanzensis*.
names.sw: Pakia, pamoja na Maundu na Tengnäs, wanatoa jina la Kidigo *mbambakofi*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kiswahili na kichwa cha neno katika kamusi ya Mgombato. Mgombato inalieleza kama *lucky-bean tree*, *pod mahogany* au *mahogany tree*, na inaorodhesha majina mengine mengi ya eneo hili, yakiwemo *mbaria*, *mbarikia*, *mkongo*, *mkola* na *mtame*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mwamba*. Kwa Kiingereza ni *pod mahogany* au *mahogany bean*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Afzelia quanzensis*.
names.dg: Pakia, na Maundu na Tengnäs, analavya dzina ra Chidigo *mbambakofi*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili na ni neno kulu kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato. Mgombato inaringanisha na *lucky-bean tree*, *pod mahogany* au *mahogany tree*, na inaandika madzina manji ganjina ga kahi ya eneo hiri, dza *mbaria*, *mbarikia*, *mkongo*, *mkola* na *mtame*. Kpwa Chigiriama ni *mwamba*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *pod mahogany* au *mahogany bean*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Afzelia quanzensis*.

conservation.en: It is becoming rare outside protected areas because of logging.
conservation.sw: Unazidi kuwa adimu nje ya maeneo yaliyohifadhiwa kwa sababu ya ukataji miti.
conservation.dg: Unakala adimu kondze ya maeneo ga hifadhi kpwa sababu ya kukatwa kpwa ajili ya mbao.
